task_description: Replace the lattice-propagation-repair t-bench task with a completely new consensus-ledger-repair task in the distributed systems domain. The new task has 6 carefully designed bugs across 5 modules dealing with Merkle trees, BFT quorum verification, Byzantine fault detection, fee computation, and double-spend detection.

verification.summary: Buggy pipeline runs without errors producing wrong values. After repair, all 26 tests pass. All 6 bugs produce observable differences: merkle_root (bugs 1,2), valid_rounds/quorum_failures (bug 3), byzantine_validators (bug 4), total_fees_collected (bug 5), double_spend_detected (bug 6), state_hash (bug 5).
